summary.scope: Profile and join refinement on supplied endpoint scaffolds. Authored sources, receiver recipes and weak defaults; no imported drawings or trained likelihoods.
summary.dependence: One pooled compatibility event per informative source. Coarse interior/defaults are prior context and never independent copies of their source evidence.
summary.metric: Fullness, equal-axis diagonals and squared curvature are conditional on an explicit equal-reach right-angle similarity premise. Omitted premise leaves those reads open.
summary.reference: 5/9-handle circle-like quarter-turn exemplar; finite signed excursions, not exact circles or global curvature maxima.
summary.control: Frozen-pool ranking with profile questions withheld, retaining the same prior. Adaptive proposal construction already uses public profile hints.

evidence.name: Three-part profile
evidence.outcome: Exposed as signed ratio bands at quarter, half and three-quarter parameter partitions
evidence.basis: Detached native partitions; private controls stay with the source
evidence.estimate: Finite cue resolution: excursion bands of width 1/24

evidence.name: Circular-like reference
evidence.outcome: A relative fullness zero, not an exact-circle claim
evidence.basis: Native quarter-turn and half-turn constructions under a selected similarity premise
evidence.note: Positive offset means greater sampled excursion than the applicable quarter/half-turn exemplar. S shapes keep a separate strength read; one number is not a universal shape identity.

evidence.name: Tangent balance
evidence.outcome: Directional balance and local squared-curvature balance are separate

evidence.estimate: Coarse directional and curvature-share bands
